summary: Complaints centre on factory pollution and the Sahibabad drain, broken and waterlogged roads, and garbage fires, while appreciation focuses on the Namo Bharat station and the Vasundhara flyover.

positives.english: Namo Bharat train from Sahibabad station runs toward Delhi and Meerut
positives.hindi: नमो भारत चलने से साहिबाबाद से दिल्ली और मेरठ जाना आसान हुआ
positives.basis: Wikipedia: Sahibabad RRTS station (Site 4, Vasundhara) was commissioned on 20 October 2023 and opened to the public on 21 October 2023; run by NCRTC on solar power. District-level source; AC membership of the station not confirmed.

positives.english: Vasundhara flyover lets Mohan Nagar traffic reach UP Gate without stopping
positives.hindi: वसुंधरा का फ्लाईओवर बनने से मोहन नगर से यूपी गेट तक जाम कम मिलता है
positives.basis: ETV Bharat (7 June 2019): Rs 49 crore Vasundhara flyover opened; it links Mohan Nagar to UP Gate and helps commuters avoid jams on the way to Industrial Area Site 4. Source is from 2019 and district-level; AC membership not confirmed.

positives.english: Easy to get to Metro and Namo Bharat stations by auto from here
positives.hindi: * मेट्रो और नमो भारत पास होने से ऑटो से आना-जाना आसान है
positives.basis: Inference: station connectivity is described in the Wikipedia RRTS page; no local voter source on auto access found for this AC.

positives.english: Drains are being built so rainwater can drain away
positives.hindi: * बारिश में पानी निकालने के लिए नाले बनाए जा रहे हैं
positives.basis: Inference: Nagar Nigam tender for an RCC drain and road in Rajendra Nagar Sector-5, work expected within 10 days; not yet a delivered benefit and AC membership unconfirmed.

positives.english: Easier to reach the industrial area from Indirapuram and Vasundhara
positives.hindi: * इंदिरापुरम और वसुंधरा से इंडस्ट्रियल एरिया जाना आसान हुआ
positives.basis: Inference: the flyover article says Indirapuram and Vasundhara residents use the flyover to reach Industrial Area Site 4; no direct resident quote found.

negatives.english: Sahibabad drain carries factory waste from about 1700 units into the Yamuna
negatives.hindi: साहिबाबाद का नाला फैक्ट्रियों का गंदा पानी यमुना तक ले जाता है
negatives.basis: ETV Bharat (28 July 2025): waste from about 1700 factories reaches the Yamuna through the Sahibabad drain; the drain runs through Sahibabad Industrial Area Site-4; DPCC report says BOD 220 mg/l against ideal 30 mg/l. District-level; Site-4 AC membership not confirmed.

negatives.english: Rainwater collects in Rajendra Nagar Sector-5 and roads are damaged
negatives.hindi: बारिश में राजेंद्र नगर सेक्टर-5 में पानी भर जाता है और सड़कें टूटी हैं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (18 Aug 2026), dateline Sahibabad: rainwater collects at several spots in Sector-5 and poor drainage has damaged roads; about 30,000 residents affected per the article. AC membership of Rajendra Nagar Sector-5 not confirmed.

negatives.english: Broken road in the Sahibabad industrial area throws dust on passers-by
negatives.hindi: टूटी सड़क से रोज धूल उड़ती है और सांसों पर आफत है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala video report (30 Oct 2025): broken road near Indraprastha Dental College in Sahibabad industrial area; vehicles passing daily kick up dust. Short report, no resident quotes. District-level; AC membership not confirmed.

negatives.english: Garbage piles along roads in Site IV industrial area catch fire and send smoke
negatives.hindi: सड़क किनारे कूड़े के ढेर में आग लगती है और धुआं फैलता है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala video report (12 Apr 2025): roadside garbage pile on fire in Sahibabad Site IV industrial area, smoke spreading. Short report, no official or resident quotes. District-level; AC membership not confirmed.

negatives.english: 120 factories in the district have not put filters on their chimneys
negatives.hindi: जिले की 120 फैक्ट्रियों ने चिमनी पर फिल्टर अब तक नहीं लगाए
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (21 Aug 2026): UPPCB sent second notices to 120 industrial units in Ghaziabad district without chimney filters, deadline 30 September 2026; the article is datelined Sahibabad but covers the district. District-level, not AC-specific.

notes: AC identity confirmed from Wikipedia list: no. 55 Sahibabad, Ghaziabad district, general seat. The Wikipedia Sahibabad page lists the AC extent as Ghaziabad (M Corp.) wards 1, 8, 9, 13, 14, 16, 18, 19, 20, 25, 26, 30, 33, 38, 41, 50, 55 and 60 of Ghaziabad Tehsil, plus PC Arthala and Makanpur of Loni KC. Site-4 industrial area, Vasundhara, Rajendra Nagar Sector-5 and the Vasundhara flyover were not matched to these wards, so AC membership is unconfirmed for every negative, hence ac_specific_negatives is 0 and all negatives are district-level. No sourced news found for Arthala or Makanpur. The Sahibabad drain status (Kasna 68 MLD plant, due 26 Aug 2026 per a 2024 NGT affidavit) is not confirmed as completed. Positives 1-2 are sourced but the flyover source is from 2019 and the station source is Wikipedia. Positives 3-5 are inference items. Field check recommended on ward membership, the Site-4 drain stretch, and any 2026 Hindi local news (Amar Ujala, Dainik Jagran, Hindustan Ghaziabad editions). Searches for local 2026 water supply, electricity, cattle and sugarcane dues in Sahibabad found nothing usable.
